item.title: Bodies of climbers killed in avalanche retrieved from Broad Peak
item.description: A search team has retrieved the remains of renowned climber Nirmal Purja and several members of his team.

item.title: Mexico deploys troops to secure avocado region after US halts imports
item.description: Mexico deployed more than 1,500 troops to its main avocado-producing state after the US suspended export inspections.

item.title: Record-high heat soars through South Korea
item.description: A record-high heatwave is sweeping through the Korean Peninsula, sending temperatures skyrocketing, reaching 42.5C.

item.title: Turkiye’s Erdogan visits Saudi Arabia: What to expect
item.description: Erdogan will meet with Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman and Pakistani PM Shehbaz Sharif, his office says.

item.title: At least six killed, 15 wounded in Thailand school shooting, police say
item.description: Authorities say suspected gunman also found dead after shooting at a school northwest of Bangkok.

item.title: Anti-Muslim US Congressman Andy Ogles loses Republican primary
item.description: Trump's endorsement fails to save Tennessee legislator who recently said 'Muslims don't belong in American society'.

item.title: AI used to create viruses not found in nature for first time
item.description: US researchers say they created 16 viruses using AI, prompting hopes for medical advances and concerns about misuse.

item.title: More than one million affected by floods in India’s Assam state
item.description: Thousands of people in India have been displaced since July after monsoon rains triggered severe flooding.

item.title: Exclusive report with the 308 people rescued by Nigerian forces
item.description: Nigerian security forces have rescued 308 people abducted in separate attacks in northern Niger and Kwara states.

item.title: Israeli raid in West Bank’s Qalandiya injures 51 Palestinians
item.description: Israeli forces arrest dozens of Palestinians near Jerusalem amid uptick in military and settler violence in West Bank.

item.title: New Mexico court orders Meta to pay $567m over harm to youths
item.description: The ruling comes in the second phase of a landmark trial, with the Instagram, Facebook owner also losing in March.

item.title: Brazil formally accuses 16 people over 2024 Voepass deadly plane crash
item.description: Official says plane was irregularly cleared for departure before crash that killed 62 people outside Sao Paulo.

item.title: Police in Argentina use tear gas to stop protesters
item.description: Al Jazeera’s Teresa Bo reports from Buenos Aires, where police fired tear gas as thousands protested.

item.title: Do you know who owns the media you watch?
item.description: Today, a total of 6 companies own 90% of the American media market.

item.title: After the floods, hunger: Mozambique’s second disaster
item.description: Lost harvests and disrupted supply routes have pushed many families deeper into food insecurity.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump says war can’t ‘go much longer’; Hormuz deal close
item.description: The US, Iran, and Oman are close to a temporary deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Travel restrictions – from Israel and Europe – trap students in Gaza
item.description: Blockades and bureaucracy turn education into an uphill journey for talented Gaza students seeking a brighter future.

item.title: ‘No red line’: South Lebanon residents outraged as Israel resumes strikes
item.description: People in southern Lebanon question their government's approach as Israel launches more attacks and displacement orders.

item.title: Trump signs executive orders banning so-called ‘birth tourism’
item.description: US President Donald Trump signed two executive orders to further limit who is eligible for birthright citizenship.

item.title: Iran’s Ghalibaf accuses Trump of conducting show diplomacy ‘on loop’
item.description: US president says he is involved in talks and war will end 'pretty soon', claiming that Iran cannot 'go much longer'.

item.title: How Abdul El-Sayed’s ‘extraordinary’ win stunned pro-Israel establishment
item.description: Michigan progressive fended off AIPAC as well as Democratic establishment in US Senate race, supporters say.

item.title: Far-right fitness clubs mask extremist recruitment, experts warn
item.description: Al Jazeera's Nils Adler reports on how far-right 'Active Clubs' use fitness and camaraderie to recruit young white men.

item.title: Trump signs new executive orders seeking to limit US birthright citizenship
item.description: The US president's latest effort comes after Supreme Court ruled against his push to reinterpret constitutional right.

item.title: Toronto police arrest two in US Consulate shooting investigation
item.description: Suspects recruited via encrypted app and offered money for violent acts, Toronto police reveal after arrests.

item.title: US diplomat Rubio targets Cuban military officials, companies in sanctions
item.description: US says the five entities and eight individuals sanctioned help Cuba acquire military equipment from Russia and China.
